body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #258 head 391d2b4c (update-branch of the diff head efe6735e onto main 67451fc6 by the orchestrator) (dotfiles-T97, documentation-only residual of the Claude-sandbox GitHub investigation): the Worker Playbook step 4 and the rule's worker-commands bullet now state the finding (on Linux, gh backed by the host keyring answers HTTP 401 inside the sandbox because AF_UNIX socket creation is denied and allowUnixSockets cannot grant a path), keep git fetch inside the sandbox, carry the temporary exception for gh, git push and any authenticated git fetch against a private HTTPS remote (the credential helper is gh; revise round 2, efe6735e, after the task-level audit of 5b6b0d9f showed a globally installed rule cannot be scoped by this repository being public) through the permission gate until T90 provisions a sandbox-readable worker credential, and drop the duplicated blocked-PONG sentence (revise round 1, 68e19ef7).
